newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL JULY COFFEE EXPORTS 1.03 MLN BAGS - ABECAFE.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL JULY COFFEE EXPORTS 1.03 MLN BAGS - ABECAFE.

text.p: Brazilian green coffee exports totaled 1.03 million 60-kg bags in July according to the Industry and Commerce Ministry, the Brazilian Coffee Exporters' Association (Abecafe) said in a statement.

This was 12 percent down from the 1.18 million bags shipped in the same month last year but Abecafe is still anticipating total shipments in 1997 to reach 16.5 million bags, up 27 percent from 1996, it added.
On Tuesday, Brazil's Coffee Exporters' Federation (Febec) plotted July shipments at 916,598 bags against 1.16 million bags in the same month last year.
Using MICT statistics, total shipments to end-July this year were 8.57 million bags against 5.07 million bags in the first seven months of 1996, a rise of 69 percent, Abecafe said.
Revenue from coffee sales reached $1.6 billion to the end of July, making it the country's fourth largest export earner.
Febec estimated January to July exports this year at 8.49 million bags against 4.92 million in the same period in 1996.
